The Security Deposit shall be in the same currency(ies) in which contract is to be signed/ issued. In case of equipment, SDBG shall not be individual equipment wise. The SDBG shall remain valid up to 2 months after completion of supplies and acceptance of materials by the consignee in case of supply contracts and in case of contracts for equipment involving installation and commissioning, 2 months after the supply and commissioning of all the equipment covered in the contract. f.
